description: This file implements a login page component for a Next.js frontend, including UI elements for email/password login, role switching, and social login buttons, along with some SVG graphics and utility functions.

methods.name: clampNextPath
methods.description: Ensures the 'next' path parameter is a safe internal path and avoids redirect loops.

methods.name: setAuthCookie
methods.description: Sets a client-side cookie 'cn_auth' with role and email information, including timestamp.

methods.name: LoginClient
methods.description: Main React component for the login UI, handling form state, submission, and rendering of different login interface parts.
